applicabilityBasis.summary: The exact yBOLD product is a transferable ERC-4626 Stability Pool position receipt. Yearn states that one yBOLD represents one BOLD and bare yBOLD does not accrue yield; the separate ysyBOLD product compounds yield. Redemption is for underlying BOLD subject to protocol principal-loss risk, rather than an issuer obligation to pay a fixed amount of national currency or deposit money. The strategy-position classification follows the reviewed holder accounting and GENIUS section 2(17) and 2(22), rather than a general DeFi or securities exclusion.

references.label: Yearn yBOLD documentation: BOLD Stability Pool receipt and separate ysyBOLD product

genius.notes: Bare yBOLD must not be described as the appreciating ysyBOLD vault. DEX liquidity and transferability do not establish a fixed-monetary-value issuer repayment obligation. No token-specific GENIUS approval or legally identified payment-stablecoin issuer is claimed. Liquity BOLD authorization or applicability does not pass through to the Yearn receipt. This is an editorial scope assessment, not a binding legal determination.
